criteria.pairing: Manifest UTF-16 source spans, verified line counts, original PDF order; no text or y sorting
criteria.sampleUnit: One superscript or subscript run per case; six Hs are not independent samples
criteria.predictionPolicy: Report every frozen candidate; no nearest winner, fitting, or tolerance expansion
criteria.limitations: Admission does not prove Word quiescence or internal logical size. OS/2 fields are competing predictions, not evidence of Word usage.

failures.note: 噪声底为 0（§5）：这不是量得不准，是引擎错或配对错。

engineComparison.toleranceNote: 噪声底 0.0000pt（§5）：非零差不可能是量得不准。
